description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'EventBusTenantAdapter' which serves as an adapter to bind a TenantService to a Vert.x event bus. It handles incoming tenant-related requests, performs validation, creates tracing spans, and delegates request processing to the underlying tenant service. It supports processing 'get' tenant requests via the event bus, with mechanisms for error handling and tracing.

classes.name: EventBusTenantAdapter
classes.description: An abstract adapter class that binds a TenantService to the Vert.x event bus, handling incoming tenant API requests, validating them, creating tracing spans, and routing to specific tenant service methods.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Abstract method that returns the TenantService instance to which requests are forwarded.

methods.name: getEventBusAddress
methods.description: Returns the event bus address for tenant requests, default implementation.

methods.name: processRequest
methods.description: Handles incoming tenant API requests, routing them based on the operation (e.g., 'get') or to custom handlers.

methods.name: processGetRequest
methods.description: Processes 'get' tenant requests by parsing parameters, creating tracing spans, and delegating to getById or getByCa methods.

methods.name: processGetByIdRequest
methods.description: Fetches tenant information by tenant ID from the TenantService.

methods.name: processGetByCaRequest
methods.description: Fetches tenant information by subject DN from the TenantService.

methods.name: newChildSpan
methods.description: Creates a new tracing span for a tenant service operation, tagging it with relevant information including tenant ID.

methods.name: processCustomTenantMessage
methods.description: Default handler for non-standard or unsupported tenant requests, returning a 400 Bad Request failure.
